text:
```yaml
name: Build Android Port

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build-android:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 8
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 8

      - name: Setup workspace
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/setup-workspace.sh
          ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests

      - name: Build Android port
        run: |
          source tools/env.sh
          chmod +x scripts/build-android-port.sh
          ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests -Dskip.javadoc=true
```
